question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Animals, Horses, Trees
solution:
The logic followed here is,

 
• All horses are animals, so the 'Horses' circle is a subset of the 'Animals' circle.
 
• Trees are living organisms, but they are not animals. Therefore, the 'Trees' circle has no intersection with the 'Animals' or 'Horses' circles.
